entries.title: Driftland: The Magic Revival
entries.definitive_edition: Driftland: The Magic Revival on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native desktop release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Driftland: The Magic Revival released on April 18, 2019. It is a Star Drifters RTS/4X/god-game hybrid with online PvP/co-op, Workshop support, achievements, and a level editor, with Windows and macOS support. No console, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the preferred archive route for capture/settings control, with macOS as a native desktop alternative.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for the main archive route. Use macOS only as a native convenience alternative.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched Steam build.
